column5: Look: a graphite pencil drawing on off-white paper, as if the whole night is sketched in a notebook; loose, slightly wobbling lines redrawn a few times a second (line boil), cross-hatching for every shadow, heavy smudged darks in the corners; one accent colour only, a red pencil for hits, blood and the off licence's neon sign. A bare bulb swinging over the ramp throws a circle of light where the hatching thins. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
References: Sifu for martial-arts depth (parry timing, guard breaks, strings; values only) *(guessed)*.

View: first person, 2.5D (drawn perspective) · Camera: fixed eye height, facing the shutter onto the alley; one key turns you 180° to face the car on its ramp. Your own arms and legs drawn in the foreground.
First-person fists and feet drawn on screen, each move with its own pose: jab, cross, hook, elbow, front kick, spinning back kick, guard, parry
Combo strings (J J K, J K K, K K L ...) listed on the pause screen
Guard to block (chip damage) and a timed parry that staggers and opens a counter window
Slip left/right dodges
5 enemy kinds, each attacking differently: hoodie thug, crowbar brute, knife lad, car thief, the Gaffer (boss)
The car on the ramp, a HOTWIRE bar, and turning round to defend it
Tyre iron from the workbench: heavier hits, breaks after a few swings
Night clock 11 PM to 6 AM, a wave an hour, combo grade per hit string
Pencil look with line boil, hatching, red accent; sound through Web Audio

combos and parries · in the slice
11 PM.
The shutter is half up; across the alley the off licence sign buzzes red.
One lone hoodie walks in under the shutter.

On-screen hints teach by doing: jab him (J), then he winds up a slow haymaker with a clear flash, and the hint says "tap SPACE as it lands": the parry staggers him with a crack, and the follow-up "J J K" lands a red-lined one-two-hook that drops him.
Ten seconds later two more arrive and one slips past you toward the car; the HOTWIRE bar starts filling and "S" turns you round to drag him off the motor.
That turn, with the other robber at your back, is the hook paying off.
First real trouble at wave 2 (around minute 2): a crowbar brute who blocks jabs plus a knife lad whose fast stabs punish mashing, while a car thief sneaks in.
Health is one bar with no lives: lose it, or let the car be driven off, and the night restarts from 11 PM.
Waves grow by the hour; 4 AM brings two armed at once, and 5 AM brings the gang's boss, the Gaffer, with a bat and feints.
Survive to 6 AM dawn to win.
